effects.description: [DON!! x1] [Your Turn] All of your Characters gain +1000 power.
conditions: You have 1 DON!! card attached to your Leader
steps: Attach 1 active DON!! card from your DON!! area to this Leader
All of your Characters gain +1000 power during this turn
notes: You do not need to activate this effect manually
This effect works automatically during your turn while your Leader has 1 DON!! attached
The power boost ends after your turn
